label: Gluten Free
definition: Regulated definition in AU/NZ (no detectable gluten), EU/UK (≤20 mg/kg, Reg. 828/2014), US (<20 ppm, 21 CFR 101.91); evidence class E1 test or certification

label: Vegan
definition: No regulated definition in the seeded markets; certification (E2) or manufacturer declaration (E3) with ingredient consistency check

label: Vegetarian
definition: No regulated definition in the seeded markets; declaration with ingredient consistency check

label: Dairy Free
definition: Free-from claim; must be consistent with allergen declarations (CDS-1700 §8)

label: Lactose Free
definition: Regulated thresholds in some markets (EU national rules); declaration with evidence

label: Nut Free
definition: Free-from claim; must be consistent with allergen declarations and precautionary statements

label: Egg Free
definition: Free-from claim; consistency with allergen declarations required

label: Soy Free
definition: Free-from claim; consistency with allergen declarations required

label: Halal
definition: Certification claim (E2) naming the certifying body

label: Kosher
definition: Certification claim (E2) naming the certifying agency

label: Organic
definition: Regulated in AU (ACO/NASAA under export standard), EU (Reg. 2018/848), US (USDA NOP), Canada (COR); certification required

label: Non-GMO
aliases: gmo free;non gmo;no genetically modified ingredients
definition: Certification or declaration; regulated GM labelling rules apply separately

label: No Added Sugar
definition: Nutrition content claim with regulated conditions (FSANZ 1.2.7; EU 1924/2006; 21 CFR 101.60)

label: Sugar Free
definition: Nutrition content claim with regulated thresholds

label: Low Sugar
definition: Nutrition content claim with regulated thresholds

label: Low Fat
definition: Nutrition content claim with regulated thresholds

label: Low Sodium
definition: Nutrition content claim with regulated thresholds

label: High Protein
definition: Nutrition content claim with regulated thresholds

label: High Fibre
definition: Nutrition content claim with regulated thresholds

label: Keto
definition: No regulated definition; manufacturer declaration (E3) only

label: Paleo
definition: No regulated definition; manufacturer declaration (E3) only

label: Low FODMAP
definition: Certification programmes exist (E2); otherwise declaration
